exposure: Exposure to anesthesia during the first years of life
Exposure to anesthesia after the first years of life
finding: Early exposure to anesthesia, whether in utero, during the first years of life, or later, was not associated with an increased risk of developing ASD or a more severe form of the disorder.
mod_finding: Children born via cesarean delivery did not have a statistically significant difference in ASD diagnosis compared to those born vaginally (p=0.1113).
followup_time: Up to age 2 years (developing brain period)
